alt: L.A. Care Health Plan official expedited grievance acknowledgement letter dated July 15, 2026, promising a 72-hour clinical resolution by July 17, 2026, which the plan defaulted on.
full_text: L.A. Care Health Plan. July 15, 2026. NICOLAS HERNANDEZ. Reference Number: REDACTED. Line of Business: MCLA. Date of Service: July 14, 2026. Dear NICOLAS HERNANDEZ, Thank you for bringing your concern(s) to our attention on July 14, 2026. L.A. Care will review your expedited grievance and provide a response to you. You will receive a resolution on the matter within 72 hours from the time we received your request. If your matter is urgent, such as those involving a serious threat to your health, you may call DMHC right away without first filing a grievance or appeal with L.A. Care. Quava Anderson, Appeals & Grievances Specialist, Grievances and Appeals Department, L.A. Care Health Plan.
summary: Official L.A. Care expedited grievance acknowledgement letter dated July 15, 2026, for a clinical crisis grievance received on July 14, 2026. Although the letter explicitly promises a resolution within 72 hours (by July 17, 2026) under Knox-Keene Section 1368.01, L.A. Care defaulted and issued zero response, leaving the clinical emergency completely abandoned.
